# Look recipes: Dark and dread

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_references.py from scripts/catalog.py. Edit the catalogue, then rebuild. -->

Read this file when the user names a crime film, a noir, a horror or a dread mood.
A recipe is that look as decisions, in words that name no film and no person. The id is the neutral name.

## Dark family crime drama

`id: crime-drama-patriarch`

**What makes that look:**

- The light comes from straight above. The eyes sink into shadow, so the viewer cannot read the person.
- The colour is warm amber and the picture is dark. Most of the room is black.
- The camera is still, or it moves forward very slowly. Power sits and waits.

- **Shot:** Push-in (dolly in) (`push_in`).
- **Light:** Pool of top light.
- **Grade:** Film print, deep blacks.
- **Prompt words:** the light comes from straight above, so the eyes sink into shadow; warm amber tones, underexposed, most of the room black; the camera at eye height, almost still.
- **Other shots of this look:** Locked-off wide (tableau); Long-lens profile close-up; Rack focus (focus pull).

## Black-and-white noir

`id: noir-shadows`

**What makes that look:**

- There is no colour. Hard light and deep black shadows make the picture.
- Light comes through blinds or a doorway. It puts stripes and hard shapes on walls and faces.
- People are often dark shapes. The viewer sees less than they want to.

- **Shot:** Silhouette shot (`silhouette`).
- **Light:** Blade of light.
- **Grade:** Black and white.
- **Prompt words:** black and white, hard light through window blinds that puts stripes of light and shadow across the wall and the figure, deep black, long shadows on the ground.
- **Other shots of this look:** Dutch angle (canted frame); Long-lens profile close-up; Low-angle wide shot.

## Dolly-zoom dread

`id: dolly-zoom-dread`

**What makes that look:**

- The person stays the same size. The room behind them stretches or rushes closer.
- It shows a feeling from inside the person: a shock, a fear of falling.
- The place is ordinary. The effect happens 1 time.

- **Shot:** Dolly zoom (vertigo effect) (`dolly_zoom`).
- **Light:** Soft window light from one side.
- **Grade:** Film print, deep blacks.
- **Prompt words:** the person keeps the same size while the background stretches or rushes closer, one window light from the side with a real dark side, an ordinary place.
- **Other shots of this look:** Push-in (dolly in); Dutch angle (canted frame); Slow zoom-in.

## Cold corridor dread

`id: corridor-dread`

**What makes that look:**

- A wide lens looks down a corridor. All the lines run to 1 point.
- The camera glides behind the person, low and perfectly steady.
- The light is cold and even. Nothing is hidden, and that is the fear.

- **Shot:** Follow shot (from behind) (`follow_behind`).
- **Light:** Night, practical lights only.
- **Grade:** Cool and desaturated.
- **Prompt words:** a wide lens, all lines run to one point in the middle of a long corridor, a smooth steady follow close behind the person, cold even light from the lamps of the place.
- **Other shots of this look:** Push-in (dolly in); Locked-off wide (tableau); Slow zoom-in.

## Slow-burn horror

`id: slow-burn-horror`

**What makes that look:**

- The frame is wide and still, and it stays too long.
- The lens tightens so slowly that the viewer notices late.
- Something small and wrong is far back in the dark. Nobody points at it.

- **Shot:** Slow zoom-in (`slow_zoom`).
- **Light:** Cold moonlight.
- **Grade:** Cool and desaturated.
- **Prompt words:** a wide still frame held too long, a slow tightening of the lens, something small and wrong far back in the dark part of the frame.
- **Other shots of this look:** Locked-off wide (tableau); Rack focus (focus pull); Point-of-view shot (POV).
